name: Runtime evidence floor
section: Finishing rungs — what stands between "stopped talking" and "delivered"
prose: a turn that wrote runnable source (by file suffix; documentation and config do not count) and executed no command at all gets exactly one reminder to prove the change by running it: fast gate first, then the changed path and the callers it reaches, a throwaway harness in the system temp dir deleted in the same turn, judged on exit codes/stdout/logs rather than on a screenshot it cannot see. Deterministic, once per turn, and a reminder rather than a block. A command that ran and exited nonzero still counts as an observation.
invariant: A turn that edited source and ran no command gets one reminder naming the files; it reminds, never blocks.
